'''Pree Bandari''' was a member of the [[InterStellar Regulators]] who served during the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]]. Bandari was reprimanded by [[Efflan Jor]] when the Regulator requested the access codes for the [[Hutt Embassy]] in [[Talaos City]], though Bandari lost a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with the codes.
